name: Creatorem UI
summary: React components that complement shadcn/ui: tour, stepper, quick form, QR code, liquid motion.
description: A component collection that complements shadcn/ui with missing pieces: confirm button, number/phone/speech inputs, quick form, QR code, progression, skeleton, stepper and tour, plus motion components such as dialog, glow, liquid glass, liquid slider and liquid switch. Built with Radix primitives, TypeScript and Tailwind; some components are only available in the paid Creatorem SaaS kit.
contains: components: tour, stepper, confirm button, quick form, QR code, number/phone/speech input
motion: dialog, glow, liquid glass, liquid slider, liquid switch
layout: ratio preserver, device mockup, skeleton
utility hooks: copy to clipboard, input drag, delay
some components only in the paid SaaS kit
